concerns.text: FR‑015 requires a verification step that the sentiment dataset contains ≥ 10 k records before any downstream processing. No task in the current list performs this check; T004 simply downloads the placeholder dataset and downstream tasks (T005‑T010) consume it unvalidated.

FR‑021 mandates a feasibility check that the total number of VAR parameters does not exceed (observations / 5) before model fitting. No task implements this check; T007 fits the model directly, so the required producer is missing.

FR‑014 specifies PELT change‑point detection on the sentiment ILR components and reporting of breakpoint‑recession alignment. The task list contains only T012 (visualisation) but no task that runs the PELT algorithm or produces the required breakpoint metrics.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires that raw files be checksummed and the checksums recorded. No task creates or records SHA‑256 checksums for any raw data files (e.g., the CSVs downloaded in T003/T004).

Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates the project directory layout, a shared filesystem operation. If multiple workers execute tasks in parallel, concurrent directory creation could cause race conditions; the safety of the `[P]` tag is questionable.
